div.head: I Cn 2.3
div.ab: And gyf æfre ænig mann heonon forð Godes cyricgrið swa abrece, þæt he binnon ciricwagum mannslaga weorðe, þonne sig þæt botleas, ⁊ ehte his ælc þæra þe Godes freond sig, butan þæt geweorðe þæt he þanon ætberste ⁊ swa deope friðsocne gesece, þæt se cyningc him þurh ðæt feores geunne wiþ fulre bote ge wið God ge wið menn.

And gif æfre anig man heonon forð Godes cyricgrið swa abrece, þæt he binnan cyricwagum manslaga wæorðe, þonne is þæt botleas, ⁊ ehte his ælc þara þe Godes freond sy, butan þæt geweorðe, þæt he þano[n] ætberste ⁊ swa deope friðsocne gesece, þæt se cyningc hym þurh þæt feores geunne, wið fulre bote ge wið Godd ge wyð menn.

Si quis amodo pacem ęcclesię Dei uiolabit, ut inter parietes eius homicidium faciat, hoc inemendabile sit, et persequatur eum omnis qui Deum diligit, nisi contingat, ut per aliquod pacis confugium rex ei uitam concedat, plenis emendationibus erga Deum et homines.

And gyf æfre ænig mann heonon forð Godes cyricgrið swa abrece þæt he binnon ciricwagum mannslaga weorþe, þonne sig þæt botleas, ⁊ ehte his ælc þæra þe Godes freond sig, butan þæt geweorðe þæt he þanon ætberste ⁊ swa deope friðsocne gesece, þæt se cyningc him þurh ðæt feores geunne wiþ fulre bote ge wið God ge wið menn.

And if ever anyone henceforth violates the protection of the church of God by committing homicide within its walls, that crime shall not be atoned for by any payment of compensation, and everyone who is the friend of God shall pursue the miscreant, unless it happen that he escapes from there and reaches so inviolable a sanctuary that the king, because of that, grants him his life, upon condition that he makes full amends both towards God and towards men.

Und wenn je hinfort jemand den Sonderfrieden einer Kirche Gottes so weit verletzt, dass er innerhalb der Kirchenmauern Todtschläger wird, dann sei dies unabbüssbar, und verfolge ihn jeder derer, der Gottes Freund ist; ausser wenn es geschieht, dass er von dannen entkomme und ein so gewichtiges Friedensasyl erreiche, dass um dessen willen der König ihm das Leben schenkt, bei voller Busse sowohl gegenüber der Kirche als den Weltlichen:

And if ever henceforth anyone so violates the protection of God's church that he becomes a manslayer within the church walls, then that is beyond compensation, and let everyone who is God's friend pursue him; unless it happens that he escapes from there and reaches so weighty a sanctuary that for its sake the king grants him his life, on full compensation both to God and to men:
